description: §15.11.4 (S459 round 7, item 3) — `not` inhabits an optional function prop's type (`fn | not`), so passing it explicitly (`onGo=${not}`, `onGo=not`) is admitted — not E-TYPE-031 — and the emitted JS is valid: the guarded call takes the else branch and the optional call does nothing. A793e24e5 emitted a syntax error (`not()` lowered as the `not` operator); round 6 refused it as a non-function value.
rationale: §15.11.4: "An optional function-typed prop (declared with `?`) that is not provided at the call site SHALL have value `not` inside the component body" — `not` is a value of the prop's type, so passing it is assignable.
